name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.8 degrees south of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 18 times in 5 visits over 56 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 36 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.3 days starting 2025-07-21, at wavelengths from 0.77 to 4.40 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
